answer: Rotating Nectar Assignment. Each epoch, a public verifiable random beacon draws a saffron-scored subset of agents to audit a random slice of recent activity. An identity only earns the nectar reward if its audit slice was assigned after the beacon fired, so an attacker cannot precompute which identities must act. Identities that stay dormant through their assigned epoch lose a fixed relic credit per identity, roughly the cost of maintaining it. Splitting into many identities multiplies dormant-epoch penalties, making mass sybils pay linearly.
